mapper.sql: t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, t2.book_name, t3.index_name, ifnull(t4.nick_name, t4.username) as create_user_name

mapper.delete: delete from book_paragraph_comment where id = #{id} or root_id = #{id}
